tldr: Lilith in Capricorn: the wound around failure; feeling carried alone behind a managed exterior.
body: With Lilith in Capricorn, rejection confirms the deepest fear: not being enough to succeed. The response is control: pessimism as protection, emotions withdrawn and managed, every burden carried alone because needing help looks like failing.
gift: Endurance, discipline, and composure that can carry real responsibility.
challenge: Melancholy and expecting the worst, emotional coldness, refusing help until the load breaks something.
note: Distilled from the Black Moon Lilith compilation (Resources/937057437-Lillith-Black-Moon.docx), 'Black Moon Lilith in the Signs' long-form chapter. Lilith reads as a wound-point: shame and rejection processed through the sign's style. Owner-reviewed for live use, 2026-07-28.
